rongmei.title: Bumaeng samkei o, Eden khou puat guai

lines: 1. Bumaeng samkei o, Eden khou puat guai,
Muh ngam louna nang ramgai tei zuanni;
Houni kagun daih gaimei kapumna,
Thuanhpui khuan mpuan kumna liulou ni.
Immanuel nang zauzian pi lung khou,
Rianra pui rih daih e ‘na guang datro,
Ngalan guang o aniu ringhmei nang e,
Nang zauzian pi lung khou hei,
Rianrapui rih daih e.
2. He! Neihlamei le suaihiampui tingmik,
Nang ringhmei chaeng gaimei khou zailou o;
He! Jordan dui daihmei rui kamuatna,
Kanaan ramgai khou zai kan pat lou o.
3. Sam thaina akhouhna kum sam e thei,
Ai ringhmei Kalvary ching sam tangni;
Kandi ramgai hei ai loudu pukhou,
Neihlapui ram gaimei tei nzuanni.
4. He! Ai neihlaa pui tingmik maan pukhou,
Neihlamei namdaih gai khou ai bamni;
Kalvary ching thuanna ai lu suanni,
Khaengh loumei tei ‘mu makna suan bamni.
